description:
(Summary from jobright.ai; the original posting may say more.)

Lockheed Martin is hiring a Software Engineer to maintain software and systems configuration management tools and processes. The role supports software configuration, builds, baselines, change control, and customer deliveries.
Software Engineer, Configuration Management, maintaining software and systems baselines, building releases, and facilitating change control.

Responsibilities:
• The Software Engineer maintains Software and Systems Configuration Management tools and processes to support configuration identification, control, reporting, build, installation, and delivery of both internally developed and externally purchased commercial off-the-shelf (COTS) software products
• Performs configuration management software builds, creates, assigns, and verifies configuration item part numbers, titles, and media numbers in accordance with established requirements
• Maintains the Software Configuration Management System
• Burns media for software deliveries to the customer
• Maintains Specification Requirement baselines
• Facilitates the Change Control Board (CCB) to ensure proper oversight and approval of software changes
• Data Transfer Agent (DTA)

Requirements:
• Bachelor's degree from an accredited college with minimum of 1-2 years relevant work experience
• Working knowledge of Unix/Linux and Windows operating system
• Ability to follow commands for Software builds
• Ability to multi-task
• Working knowledge associated with build automation and scripting
• Software/Firmware Configuration Management or entry level Software Engineering experience
• Working knowledge of System Specifications /Requirements
• Experience working within an AGILE software development environment
• Candidate must be able to obtain and maintain a security clearance at the SECRET level

Preferred:
• Solid interpersonal skills, strong written and verbal communication
• Engineering tools experience with Jira, GitLab, DOORs
• Familiarity of Configuration Management principles and Operating Industry standards: ISO 9001, AS9100, and Capability Maturity Model Integration (CMMI), EIA-649 / MIL-HDBK-61
• Ability to write Basis of Estimate (BOE)
• Proficient in Microsoft products (Word, Excel, PowerPoint)
